title: Travis Taylor arrives as a skeptic

tellings.quote: and a team member. I mean when Dr. Taylor flew out to the ranch with me for the first time, he was an absolute skeptic.

plain: The scientist Dr. Travis Taylor, a member of the research team at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, arrived there as a firm doubter, according to the ranch's owner. The owner tells Michels he flew out to the ranch with Taylor the first time and that Taylor "was an absolute skeptic." The point of telling it is that what Taylor later saw there was enough to change a doubter's mind.
